description: Use this when the user wants to find job vacancies, a list of jobs for a profession and city, or salary levels for a profession on Finder (finder.work for Russia and *.finder.work country sites). Returns up to 10 results with id, title and canonical finder.work URL; call fetch with an id to read the full vacancy, listing or salary page. Do not use for writing resumes, career advice without job data, applying to a job, or contacting employers: this tool only reads public data. Examples: "бухгалтер Казань", "удалённая работа python", "зарплата водителя в Москве".

query.description: Natural-language job or salary question, e.g. 'бухгалтер Казань', 'python developer Berlin remote', 'зарплата водителя в Москве'
query.title: Query

name: search

id.description: Stable result id '<country>:<vacancy|listing|salary>:<key>', pass it to fetch
id.title: Id

title.description: Result title in the site language
